comments.comment: I’m going to do this work out and update every couple days. I am 15, male. I don’t go to the gym or lift weights, but I am an excellent runner and exercises around 8 hours a week. I can see the outline of my 6 pack under good lighting. I slightly increased the difficulty of each exercise since I have a relatively strong core(w leg raises from 5 reps to 8, all 45 second exercises to 1 minute, and crunches from 10 reps to 20). I am 5’11 without shoes, and 68 kg(150lbs) with an empty stomach.  I’ve been doing this for 5 days. I have not noticed much, my abs are not becoming more defined(I’m not on calorie deficit and my diet is not very strict, although I do try to avoid any processed foods)but I do feel my core getting stronger and the sets I can do slightly increasing. Will update  Update: Day 7, still no significant difference in terms of muscle size and definition, my abs got a bit stronger compare to day 5. I also noticed that my 5km time has decreased(20:16 to 19:55) and I don’t feel as tired after finishing the run, but I don’t know whether the 22day Ab workout is the main contributor or not  Update: Day 10, almost half way. There isn’t much to say really, core definitely feels a lot stronger compare to day 1, can do around 50% more sets than before, no change in muscle size and definition  Update:Have no idea what day this is, but I’m seeing great results. My ab definition improves a LOT, I look like a fitness model with the right lighting(if u ignore my noodle arms 😂). This is definitely worth it. I would also recommend rowans 5 minute oblique workout, I believe it is a great addition to this exercise. Also according to some articles I read online, ab workout everyday is not very efficient, so I changed to 1 rest every 2 days.
